notes: #231's knee: KV fp8 read ~-4% at 16k and ~+2.7% at 196k with nothing between; this ladder bisects the crossover so any future depth gate has a measured knee instead of a guess
rationale: kv_fp8_enabled(): unset = G4MOE_KV_FP8_DEFAULT_ON = false, and explicit '0' parses to the same false — so bf16-default {} and bf16-null {NV_G4MOE_KV_FP8:'0'} are a genuine null pair. The fp8 arm quantizes KV values, which is NOT reassociation-class: the speed knee measured here does NOT discharge the quality half of #231 — per 08.2 section 3 a value-quantization arm owes windowed dppl/dacc at an engaged depth against the family's measured null (0.232 spread) before any gate ships, and that read is deliberately not in this spec (multi-hour wgpu prefill economics, the g4qual snapshot design is the template when sanctioned). Depths bracket the sign change; the foldgate rows say the fold arms dominate deep, so this runs on the same base_env as the foldgate ladder (KV_RING on, foldgate unset = off) to keep the comparison to the prior +-cells clean. compare --a/--b with the crossover printout is the read per 08.4. 250W cells per #278.
